execution_source: CLI and validation scripts must be committed; pass exact resulting commit to run-pipeline.sh
purpose: Retained software correctness checks, not research trials or timing comparisons
prerequisite: Original cap-fix pipeline terminal success; materialized exact-HEAD dependencies and full maintained examples; live Conductor ownership

materialization_inventory.binding: Before and after every phase, verify inventory SHA, every recorded blob against the execution commit with one git ls-tree read, and every materialized file SHA and size

source_binding: Compare all tracked paths against execution commit except docs/session-logs/** and this task's exact store-index.json; reject untracked Rust/Cargo/config inputs. Restored sparse inputs also require explicit byte checks.
sequence: v6 retained curve and twist CLI fixture with negative control

resource_envelope.target_reuse: sequential only, original binary already frozen separately

stop_rule: Stop on first failure; preserve preflight/command/readback stage and exit status in log and receipt. Upload both with fresh byte readback. For CLI failure also archive partial fixture outputs and frozen binary before propagating the original failure. No automatic retry.
claim_boundary: No exact fall-degree or model-efficacy claim
runtime_source: The exact execution commit passed to run-pipeline.sh; all tracked source and restored-input hashes checked before and after each phase
attempt_identity: Explicit two-digit argument, default01; attempt02 follows a recorded compile failure and local manifest refactor. Never reuse existing logs/receipt/output.

prior_attempt.failure: JSON macro recursion limit in exporter manifest; no tests executed
